# Project Expedition

> > Travel guide and tour resource for eco-adventures, archaeological sites, and outdoor activities across Central America, South America, Africa, and Asia.

Project Expedition specializes in curated sights and attractions across Panama, Peru, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Belize, and other adventure destinations. The site features detailed guides for eco-tours, snorkeling, hiking, archaeological exploration, and wildlife experiences with a focus on sustainable tourism.

## Key Topics

- Panama attractions
- Bocas del Toro
- Cusco & Machu Picchu region
- Guatemala eco-tours
- Snorkeling & diving sites
- Archaeological exploration
- Eco-tourism
- Central America travel
- South America destinations
- Outdoor activities & hiking
- Island hopping
- Wildlife & nature tours
- Sightseeing tours
- Adventure travel
- Sustainable tourism

## Panama Attractions & Islands

- [Solarte Island](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/solarte-island): Solarte Island attraction in Bocas del Toro, Panama with snorkeling tours
- [Azuero Peninsula](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/azuero-peninsula): Azuero Peninsula tours and island destinations in Panama
- [Mamoni River](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/mamoni-river): Mamoni River eco-tours in Chepo, Panama
- [Mangrove Point](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/mangrove-point): Mangrove Point snorkeling & kayaking in Bocas del Toro, Panama
- [Metropolitan Cathedral Panama](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/metropolitan-cathedral-panama): Metropolitan Cathedral religious site in Panama City

## Peru Archaeological Sites & Inca Heritage

- [Awana Kancha](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/awana-kancha): Awana Kancha archaeological site in Cusco, Peru
- [Vilcabamba](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/vilcabamba): Vilcabamba archaeological site near Machu Picchu, Cusco, Peru
- [Winay Wayna](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/winay-wayna): Winay Wayna Inca ruins near Machu Picchu, Cusco, Peru
- [Plaza San Martin](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/plaza-san-martin): Plaza San Martin city tour attraction in Lima, Peru

## Guatemala Eco-Tours & Natural Wonders

- [Semuc Champey](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/semuc-champey): Semuc Champey natural pools in Alta Verapaz, Guatemala
- [Lanquin Caves](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/lanquin-caves): Lanquin Caves tours in Alta Verapaz, Guatemala

## Central America Snorkeling & Diving

- [Pigeon Cay](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/pigeon-cay): Pigeon Cay snorkeling tours in Roatan, Honduras
- [Half Moon Caye](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/half-moon-caye): Half Moon Caye diving & snorkeling in Belize District
- [Five Sisters](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/five-sisters): Five Sisters waterfalls in Cayo District, Belize near Belmopan

## Costa Rica & South America Adventures

- [Arenal Hanging Bridges](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/arenal-hanging-bridges): Arenal Hanging Bridges eco-tour in Alajuela, Costa Rica with hiking
- [Moon Valley (Chile)](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/moon-valley-chile): Moon Valley tours in San Pedro de Atacama, Chile's Atacama Desert

## International Destinations

- [Central Kalahari Game Reserve](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/central-kalahari-game-reserve): Central Kalahari Game Reserve wildlife safari in Ghanzi, Botswana
- [Nam Ngum Reservoir](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/nam-ngum-reservoir): Nam Ngum Reservoir boating tours in Vientiane, Laos
- [Jemaa El-fnaa](https://www.projectexpedition.com/attraction/jemaa-elfnaa): Jemaa El-fnaa marketplace tours in Marrakesh, Morocco
